description: Attach model run(s) to an existing HUMAN_EVAL project (from opentrain_launch_eval_work): imports a new batch of outputs as experiments and creates blind grading tasks. Same experiments contract as the launch tool ({label, modelId?, rows:[{itemKey?, prompt, output}]}); mode defaults to PAIRWISE. TRAJECTORY mode (agent-conversation review; exactly 1 experiment) takes experiments[].trajectories:[{itemKey?, messages:[...]}] INSTEAD of rows/sampleFrom — tool calls/results expand into positional review steps. Use this to add a new model version against the same prompts, or when the eval was launched without outputs. platformExport {format?, content} imports a LangSmith/Braintrust/Weave/Phoenix export directly (XOR with experiments/inspectLog). Requires open-label:write scope.

sampleFrom.description: OpenTrain samples YOUR endpoint server-side — XOR with rows

trainingRunId.description: Link to a TrainingRun (rails or external — Step 19-ext)

trajectories.description: TRAJECTORY mode only (exactly 1 experiment): agent conversations to review — replaces rows/sampleFrom

messages.description: One agent run as an OpenAI-style message list — assistant tool calls and tool results expand into positional, reviewable steps

tool_call_id.description: On role:tool results — links back to the assistant tool call

tool_calls.description: Assistant-only tool invocations: [{id?, function?: {name, arguments}} | {name, arguments}]

flaggedOnly.description: With inspectLog: import only samples the automated scorer marked imperfect

inspectLog.description: A completed Inspect JSON eval log (inspect log dump output) — imported as one SINGLE-mode experiment instead of experiments[]

platformExport.description: U94: import an observability-platform export directly — XOR with experiments and inspectLog; the parsed mode must match the project type. The response carries a platformImport summary.

content.description: The exported JSON value, or a JSON/JSONL document string

name: opentrain_attach_eval_outputs
